title: Ashramshala Apekshit Kits Project
summary: We are delighted to share that our Educational Kits 21 Apekshit for Std. X and XII Tribal Students from Ashramshala, Parli, Wada Project has been successfully completed!
description:
We are delighted to share that our Educational Kits 21 Apekshit for Std. X and XII Tribal Students from Ashramshala, Parli, Wada Project has been successfully completed!
We have been working with this school since last 5 years. This education kits will help tribal children prepare well for their board exams.
A heartfelt thank you to all our generous donors for your generous support and contribution. Because of your kindness, we were able to make this project a success and bring smiles to many deserving students.

Our sincere gratitude to all our donors:
